reason: On both sampled states the Limit type combobox has autocomplete="garbage", an invalid token set next to data-1p-ignore, data-lpignore and data-bwignore, so autofill suppression is deliberate. The field picks the period of a card spending limit, not information about the user, and the tree still exposes combobox Limit type, so no A or AA criterion fails. On cards.issue-card-success the form is still in the DOM at opacity 0 behind the success screen with the same attribute.
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose applies only to fields that collect information about the user and serve a purpose in its Input Purposes list (name, address, email, card number and so on). Limit type picks the period (Daily here) of a card's spending limit, which is card configuration, so no listed purpose matches and 1.3.5 does not apply. The tree still exposes combobox Limit type with its expanded state and popup, so 4.1.2 holds. No other A or AA criterion covers the autocomplete token.
